name: My Hero Holiday
source:
With a surprise winter storm, all travel home for the holidays has been canceled. As a new transfer into Class 1-A, will you take this chance to get to know some classmates or will villains ruin everyone's holiday plans?

[From [url=https://zerostumbleine33.itch.io/my-hero-holiday]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于突如其来的冬季风暴，所有回家过节的旅行都被取消了。作为一名新转入1-A班的学生，你会借此机会结识一些同学，还是坏人会破坏大家的假期计划？

[来自[url=https://zerostumbleine33.itch.io/my-hero-holiday]Itch.io[/url]]
